(*This Program gets the current system time and derives variables for the Year, Month, Day of Month, Hour, Minuit and Second In General this program Converts the System time to a String so that individual elements can derived*) (*An Example of the Data Time variable converted to a string would be DT#2010-9-24-14:30:31 where: Year = 2010 Month = 9 Day = 24 Hour = 14 (2pm since the RTAC will use a 24 hour time basis) Minuets = 30 Seconds = 31 *) (*Once these variables have parsed and converted into integers from a string, the results are stored into a GVL (Global Variable List)called TIME_VARS. It should be configured to the following: VAR_GLOBAL Year:INT; Month:INT; Day:INT; Hour:INT; Mins:INT; Sec:INT; END_VAR *)
Time_current:=Sys_time(); (*Get Current System Time*) current_time_string:=DT_TO_STRING(time_current.value.dateTime); (*convert System Time to String to Search in*)
Len_2_Year:=find(current_Time_String,'#'); (*Find the number of char to get to the Year reading*) time_Del_2_Year:=delete(current_time_string,(len_2_Year+1),0); (*Delete everything in the string leading up to the Year*) Year_String:=left(time_Del_2_Year,4); (*Delete everything after the digits that represent the Year*) Year:=STRING_TO_WORD(Year_String); (*Convert Year from a String Var to a Integer *)
len_2_Month:=find(Time_Del_2_Year,'-'); (*Find the number of char to get to the Month reading*) time_Del_2_Month:=delete(time_Del_2_Year,len_2_Month+1,0); (*Delete everything in the string leading up to the Month*) Len_2_Day:=find(time_Del_2_Month,'-'); (*Find the number of char to get to the Day reading*) Month_String:=left(time_del_2_month,len_2_day-1); (*Delete everything after the digits that represent the Month*) Month:=STRING_TO_WORD (Month_String); (*Convert Month from a String Var to a Integer *)
time_Del_2_Day:=delete(Time_Del_2_Month,len_2_Day+1,0); (*Delete everything in the string leading up to the Day*) len_2_hour:=find(time_Del_2_Day,'-'); (*Find the number of char to get to the Hour reading*) Day_String:=Left(time_Del_2_Day,len_2_hour-1); (*Delete everything after the digits that represent the Day*) Day:=STRING_TO_WORD(Day_String); (*Convert Day from a String Var to a Integer *)
time_Del_2_Hour:=delete(time_Del_2_Day,len_2_hour+1,0); (*Delete everything in the string leading up to the Hour*) len_2_min:=find(time_Del_2_Hour,':'); (*Find the number of char to get to the Minuets reading*) Hour_String:=left(time_Del_2_Hour,len_2_min-1); (*Delete everything after the digits that represent the Hour*) Hour:=STRING_TO_WORD(Hour_String); (*Convert Hour from a String Var to a Integer *)
Time_del_2_mins:=delete(time_Del_2_Hour,len_2_min+1,0); (*Delete everything in the string leading up to the Minuit*) len_2_sec:=find(time_Del_2_mins,':'); (*Find the number of char to get to the Seconds reading*) mins_string:=left(Time_del_2_mins,len_2_sec-1); (*Delete everything after the digits that represent the Minuit*) mins:=STRING_TO_WORD(mins_string); (*Convert Minuets from a String Var to a Integer *)
time_del_2_sec:=delete(Time_del_2_mins,len_2_sec+1,0); (*Delete everything in the string leading up to the Second*) sec:=STRING_TO_WORD(time_del_2_sec); (*Convert Seconds from a String Var to a Integer *)
(*Output to the GVL named Calender*) Calender.Day:=Day; Calender.Hour:=Hour; Calender.Mins:=Mins; Calender.Month:=Month; Calender.Sec:=Sec; Calender.Year:=Year;
